title: Private Rental Price List — Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces
content:
Prices for a private month-to-month rental of a Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed, in US dollars: the private monthly rent of the class, charged to the card in advance (per month); the private rental delivery and setup fee; the private rental pickup fee; the minimum private rental term in months; and whether a private rental's final partial month after the minimum term is prorated by day.

| Bed class | Monthly rent, charged to the card in advance | Delivery and setup fee | Pickup fee | Minimum term | Final partial month after the minimum term prorated by day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | $145.00 | $95.00 | $75.00 | 1 month | Yes |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | $165.00 | $95.00 | $75.00 | 1 month | Yes |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | $189.00 | $95.00 | $75.00 | 1 month | Yes |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | $219.00 | $95.00 | $75.00 | 1 month | Yes |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | $329.00 | $150.00 | $125.00 | 1 month | Yes |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | $799.00 | $250.00 | $200.00 | 1 month | Yes |

## Price list notes

- The monthly rent rises with the class, from $145.00 for the Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) to $799.00 for the Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304).
- The four 36-inch classes share a $95.00 delivery and setup fee and a $75.00 pickup fee; the Heavy-Duty class carries $150.00 and $125.00, and the Extra Heavy-Duty class $250.00 and $200.00.
- The minimum private rental term is 1 month for every class, and every class carries Yes for daily proration of the final partial month after the minimum term.
